conviction_note: Three small negatives that rest on inference and public series (no pre-release H1 revision this year where the company revised up in Sept 2023 and Sept 2025, so Q2 likely lost more than last year's -443m; Q2 revenue needs +15.6% y/y in a quarter where inbound fell; FY plan 2,700 likely held against a 3,300 consensus) sum to -0.75, but the scaled number is only -0.07 because the likely headline is still an upward 差異 against a low H1 plan, the name's last two H1 prints moved +0.18% and -1.64%, and it has already fallen 46% from March, so p_up sits at 48 on a 1.8% scale.
bar: Company H1 plan (May 14, reaffirmed Jul 30): revenue 28,500m, OP 0, ordinary 100m, net 50m; FY revenue 61,400m / OP 2,400m / ordinary 2,700m. Source https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260727599977.pdf . Market FY ordinary bar 3,300m (kabuyoho consensus as of 2026-10-28, target 1,140 yen, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9708). That is one aggregator and probably one analyst, so the FY bar is treated as weakly sourced and the findings that depend on it are capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is H1 revenue against the 28,500m plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-28 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, baseline). Margin ratio 信用倍率 35.98x (kabutan top page 2026-10-29, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9708): margin long is crowded, the setup where a weak number still finds sellers, and the overhang is already in priced_lean (-0.78). No crowded short, so no squeeze fuel. Run-up -5.71% over 20d and -2.41% over 5d; the stock is down from 1,000 in early Sept and from 1,645 in March. No options and no skew.

findings.finding: No H1 業績予想の修正 has been filed (TDnet lists 2026-10-19 to 10-29 and irbank's full list show nothing after the 2026-09-29 Crest Hotel Kashiwa notice), although Q1 alone (OP 716m, ordinary 775m) already exceeded the H1 plan (OP 0, ordinary 100m). The same company revised H1 up in late September in 2023 (+430m OP) and 2025 (+600m OP), and at Q1 in 2024 (+900m), whenever its internal H1 view moved materially. The silence implies management's late-September H1 view sat near the plan, i.e. Q2 (Jul-Sep) OP somewhere around -500 to -700m against -443m last year. H1 will most likely land modestly ABOVE the plan (it beat its latest H1 forecast by 72-187m OP in each of 2023-2025) but below the naive Q1-plus-last-year's-Q2 extrapolation (about 270m OP / 490m ordinary), and down sharply y/y against 319m / 556m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 print beat a low revised plan and was down y/y on 2024-10-30: -1.64% prev close to next close. H1 beat the Sept-revised plan on 2025-10-31: +0.18%. Q1 FY27 on 2026-07-30 (already over the H1 plan, down y/y): +0.80%. Computed from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9708.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The Q1 headline the market has, kabutan's '上期計画を超過' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9708&b=k202607300031), frames H1 as already beaten. Reading a missing September revision against this issuer's own revision habit is not something an aggregator shows. If the market had done it, the H1 consensus would sit near plan; the only visible street number is a FY ordinary of 3,300m, 22% above plan, which is not consistent with expecting a weak Q2. The -11% slide since early September could be partly this, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: The revision record comes from TDnet notices: https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20230926/140120230925557951.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250926/140120250919560208.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20240726/140120240725555158.pdf. The weak Q2 demand backdrop, from a different source, is finding 2 (JNTO, JHR).

findings.finding: Revenue arithmetic: the H1 revenue plan of 28,500m (+12.1% y/y) needs Q2 at about 13,687m, +15.6% on last year's 11,842m, after Q1 grew only +9.0% with the Kyoto hotel already open (since 2026-03-05). In the quarter itself, inbound arrivals fell y/y in both August and September 2026 (September -5.0%, China -44.5%, US -3.2%; JNTO via travelvoice), and JHR's 29-hotel September RevPAR rose only +1.5%, with Osaka soft against last year's Expo comp. Imperial Hotel Osaka carried that Expo demand in Q2 FY26. So H1 revenue likely falls 1-3% short of plan, with the profit beat coming from cost control, as in 2024 (revenue -1.0% against plan).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2024-10-30, revenue -1.0% against plan with profits above plan: -1.64% next close. Revenue has never been the headline line for this name; profit against plan is.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the inbound and REIT series are public. What is not on any wire is the plan arithmetic (Q2 needs +15.6% y/y) for a name with thin coverage. A proxy, sized small accordingly.
findings.independence: JNTO September arrivals, https://www.travelvoice.jp/20261021-160712 (2026-10-21), is a different source from the JHR monthly. Both are proxies, not company numbers. The plan arithmetic uses the Q1 短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260727599977.pdf, the same document as finding 1's bar.

findings.finding: This issuer does not revise its full-year plan at H1. Its H1 差異 notices of 2024-10-30 and 2025-10-31 both say '通期業績予想につきましては、現時点において変更はありません', and its FY revisions come at Q1, Q3 or late March. So the likely release holds FY ordinary at 2,700m against a 3,300m consensus, while H1 progress (likely about 10-15% of FY ordinary, against 22.2% last year) makes the H2 hurdle look steep on the screen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY held at H1 in 2024 (-1.64%) and 2025 (+0.18%). The FY27 initial guide on 2026-05-14 (OP 2,400, net -57%) moved -2.81%.
findings.why_not_priced: Weakly unpriced. A consensus 22% above plan says at least one analyst expects an upgrade path that an H1 hold does not give. But the consensus is thin and a hold is this company's habit, so most holders expect it. Capped small because the bar comes from one aggregator.
findings.independence: The 2024 H1 差異 notice with the same wording: https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20241030/140120241029505407.pdf (same issuer, a different document).

outside_window.finding: Tower building operations (rooms, banquets, offices) continue until demolition starts around the end of FY2030, a change from the earlier plan. The Q1 real-estate segment lost 226m on repair costs for the reopening. The profit path of that reopening plays out over H2 and later years, not at this print.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the negative lean (-0.49) and the -5.7% run-up, so they are not much of an edge. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward 差異 notice that kabutan headlines as '上期経常は計画上振れ' on a stock down 46% from March, a 悪材料出尽くし setup. I looked for returns (none expected) and for a pre-release revision (none filed). That positive is why p_up sits at 48 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a series the market already has): finding 2 rests on public JNTO and JHR series and on 進捗 arithmetic anyone can do, so it went from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up moved toward 50.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): all three findings were negative. I wrote the strongest positive (an upward 差異 headline, 悪材料出尽くし after a 46% fall) into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for returns and a revision. Finding 1 went from -0.5 to -0.4 because its own caveat (H1 likely beats plan) argues against it, finding 3 from -0.2 to -0.15 under the core rule capping findings that depend on a weakly sourced bar, and p_up from 45 to 48.
